questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

 

Statements:</div

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0908d2283110931fb2ee24f3d705fc6918b729f54bdf2df91a1c22d513e93b1b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No page is a notebook → Does not f**ollow** (As all pages are diaries, some diaries are books and all books are notebooks. As no direct relation is given between pages and notebooks, therefore it is false.)

II. All pages are notebooks → Does not f**ollow** (As all pages are diaries, some diaries are books and all books are notebooks. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. All diaries being notebooks is a possibility → F**ollow** (As some diaries are books and all books are notebooks. As statement restricts whole diaries from being books therefore it is possible and thus is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number

of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Virus : Parasite
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The first word is an organism that lives in or on another organism (the second word) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.**

Here,

Virus : Parasite → A parasite is an organism that lives in or on another organism (the host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

Similarly,

Amaltas : Tree → Amaltas (a type of flowering plant) lives on a tree (the host) and benefits from it.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Amaltas : Tree"**.
